source: https://mapgenie.io/halo-infinite/maps/zeta-halo (MapGenie public map data; third-party, not official)
coverage: MapGenie's full Zeta Halo collectible markers. Mission interiors are thin: most mission-bound items carry no mission link. Zone for unlinked items is a nearest-anchor heuristic. 'where' text is MapGenie's, kept for private reference -- paraphrase before any corpus or public use.

entries.label: A Warning (Outpost Intel 2/15)
entries.where: Inside the of the Banished building with the locked doors. You'll need to find the tunnel blocked by the barrier in the east end of Armory of Reckoning (image 2). Follow the cables to the energy core and destroy it to deactivate the barrier. Make you way through the tunnels, past the Spartan core, and up the grav lift into the building. Find the log in front of a big weapon hologram (image 1).

entries.where: Found during mission Foundation, scanning the room helps to find this one, but you'll need to be high and close enough for this to work. In the large chamber entered shortly after seeing the ghostly blue children (beyond the glass in image 2) - this skull is near the ceiling in the rafters (image 3). First you'll need to grapple up as high as you can on the columns that stand on the floor. From there you can shoot a grapple to the rafters where the skull is (image 1). **Tip:** Aim for just under the platform as there's a small lip that can prevent you from getting on top of the platform if you aim lower.

entries.label: Not My Fault (The Prisoner 1/7)
entries.where: Found towards the end of Foundation, on the floor next to the power cell that powers the elevator to the surface.

entries.label: The Question (Recovered Files 2/4)
entries.where: Acquired automatically during Foundation

entries.label: Drop Wall
entries.where: Automatically found during mission Conservatory

entries.label: Thruster
entries.where: Found automatically during mission Conservatory

entries.label: BR75 Breacher
entries.where: On the ground next to the dead soldier. Just slightly down the hill, southwest from the Spartan Core. **Tip:** Recommended for defeating the Brute Chieftains during mission Conservatory

entries.label: Barely Anything Left (The Prisoner 5/7)
entries.where: Inside the Nexus during mission Nexus You will eventually enter a large room with holograms of the active spires and the ring (image 2). After attempting to activate the platform, the 3 doors on each side of the room will activate. If you go through the door directly in front of you, the log will be in the first room on your left leaning against the wall (image 1).

entries.label: The Mission (Recovered Files 3/4)
entries.where: Acquired automatically during mission Nexus

entries.label: Mythic
entries.where: Found during mission _The Command Spire_. In the room with the floating hexagonal columns and the yellow energy fields - run to the back of the room and grapple on top of one of the columns. Then grapple up two more floors. There you'll find a corridor that leads to the skull.

entries.label: Grunt Birthday Party
entries.where: Found during mission _Repository_. Find the large Forerunner chamber with two light bridges connecting two platforms with doors to a center platform with an activation button. Notice the two other platforms with doors perpendicular to the light bridges - one of these areas has a power cell, the other has a power cell receptacle. You'll need to bring the cell to the receptacle (if dropped into the chasm, it will simply respawn in its original place). Continue with the mission until you reach a large room with two angled columns and a half-octagonal opening above. Grapple up and through the opening. If the power cell was not placed properly in the previous room, this opening will be covered by glass. Inside you'll find the skull and four cloaked Elites waiting for you.

entries.label: Price Paid (The Prisoner 6/7)
entries.where: Inside the Forerunner facility during mission Repository

entries.label: The Weapon (Recovered Files 4/4)
entries.where: Acquired automatically during mission Repository

entries.label: Legacy (Escharum's Testimony 9/9)
entries.where: Found during mission House Of Reckoning in the room with the pilot that is just after the fight with the Blade Master, near the back.

entries.label: Victory (Escharum's Testimony 8/9)
entries.where: In the 3rd large room during mission House Of Reckoning (?)

entries.label: Bandana
entries.where: Play the mission "Silent Auditorium" without killing any Sentinels. There will be a hallway towards the end with an elevator and a door straight ahead. If you didn't kill (or harm?) any Sentinels, the door will be open. If not, the door is gray.
